env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

mkdir $WORK/bin

cd deny
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/deny$GOEXE .
stderr 'main\.lgo:6:2: \[slop::discarded_error\]'
! exists $WORK/bin/deny$GOEXE
cd ..

cd allow
logos build -o $WORK/bin/allow$GOEXE .
! stderr .
exists $WORK/bin/allow$GOEXE
cd ..

cd forbid
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/forbid$GOEXE .
stderr 'main\.lgo:3:1: \[correctness::allow_forbidden_rule\]'
stderr 'main\.lgo:4:6: \[correctness::infinite_recursion\]'
! exists $WORK/bin/forbid$GOEXE
cd ..

cd warn
logos build -o $WORK/bin/warn$GOEXE .
stderr 'main\.lgo:6:2: warning: \[slop::discarded_error\]'
exists $WORK/bin/warn$GOEXE

logos build -o $WORK/bin/warn$GOEXE .
stderr 'main\.lgo:6:2: warning: \[slop::discarded_error\]'

logos build --json-diagnostics -o $WORK/bin/warn$GOEXE .
! stderr '^#'
! stderr 'warning:'
stderr -count=1 '^\{.*"rule_id":"slop::discarded_error".*\}$'
cd ..

cd quiet
logos build -o $WORK/bin/quiet$GOEXE .
! stderr .
exists $WORK/bin/quiet$GOEXE
logos build --json-diagnostics -o $WORK/bin/quiet$GOEXE .
! stderr .
cd ..

cd lowered
! logos build .
stderr 'logos\.toml:2:15: \[configuration::forbid_lowered\] correctness cannot be lowered below forbid'
cd ..

cd lintcmd
! logos lint ./...
stderr 'main\.lgo:6:2: \[slop::discarded_error\]'
! exists lintcmd
! exists lintcmd$GOEXE
cd ..

cd clean
logos lint ./...
! stderr .
! stdout .
! exists clean
! exists clean$GOEXE
cd ..

cd jsonbuild
! logos build --json-diagnostics -o $WORK/bin/jsonbuild$GOEXE .
! stderr '^#'
stderr -count=1 '^\{.*\}$'
cd ..

cd jsonlint
! logos lint --json-diagnostics ./...
cd ..

cd jsonwarn
logos lint --json-diagnostics ./...
cd ..

cd gotypeerr
! logos build --json-diagnostics ./...
! stderr '^#'
stderr -count=1 '^\{.*\}$'
stderr '"rule_id":""'
cd ..

cd reconfig
logos build -o $WORK/bin/reconfig$GOEXE .
! stderr .
cp logos-deny.toml logos.toml
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/reconfig$GOEXE .
stderr 'main\.lgo:6:2: \[slop::discarded_error\]'
cd ..

cd lgoapp
logos build -o $WORK/bin/lgoapp$GOEXE .
! stderr .
logos lint ./...
! stderr .
cd ..

cd clean
! go lint ./...
stderr 'go lint: unknown command'
! go build --json-diagnostics ./...
stderr 'flag provided but not defined: -json-diagnostics'
go help build
! stdout 'json-diagnostics'
cd ..

-- deny/go.mod --
module example.com/deny

go 1.27

-- deny/main.lgo --
package main

import "os"

func main() {
	os.Remove("missing")
}

-- allow/go.mod --
module example.com/allow

go 1.27

-- allow/main.lgo --
package main

import "os"

func main() {
	//logos:allow(slop::discarded_error)
	os.Remove("missing")
}

-- forbid/go.mod --
module example.com/forbid

go 1.27

-- forbid/main.lgo --
package main

//logos:allow(correctness::infinite_recursion)
func loop(n int) int {
	return loop(n)
}

func main() {
	println(loop(1))
}

-- warn/go.mod --
module example.com/warn

go 1.27

-- warn/logos.toml --
[lints]
slop = "warn"

-- warn/main.lgo --

import "os"

func main() {
	os.Remove("missing")
}

-- reconfig/go.mod --
module example.com/reconfig

go 1.27

-- reconfig/logos.toml --
[lints]
slop = "allow"

-- reconfig/logos-deny.toml --
[lints]
slop = "deny"

-- reconfig/main.lgo --
package main

import "os"

func main() {
	os.Remove("missing")
}

-- lgoapp/go.mod --
module example.com/lgoapp

go 1.27

require example.com/lgodep v0.0.0

replace example.com/lgodep => ../lgodep

-- lgoapp/main.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/lgodep"

func main() {
	println(lgodep.Name())
}

-- lgodep/go.mod --
module example.com/lgodep

go 1.27

-- lgodep/dep.lgo --
package lgodep

import "os"

func Name() string {
	os.Remove("missing")
	return "dep"
}
